rules.title: Relocation assistance for owner move-in and Ellis Act evictions (2026 adjustment)
rules.requirement: Owners must pay tenants relocation assistance for an owner move-in eviction, and the same payments for tenants evicted so the owner can remove the property from the rental market. Starting January 1, 2026, the standard payment is $19,413 and the additional payment for qualifying households is $6,471.
rules.key_value: Standard payment $19,413; additional payment for qualifying households $6,471 (1.5% inflation adjustment)
rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted for owner move-in, and tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market (Ellis Act evictions).
rules.citation: Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance; Ellis Implementation Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: The Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance requires owners to pay tenants relocation assistance in the event of an owner move-in eviction. The Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same relocation assistance payments for tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market.
rules.effective_date_phrase: will go into effect on January 1, 2026
